_comment: Mutation testing for the money logic (BAN-509). Scoped to the arithmetic that decides what a customer is charged — decimals and rounding, pricelists and combo distribution, the tax engine — because that is where a surviving mutant means money is wrong, and because it is mirrored line for line in PHP and driven by the same fixture corpus. The first run covered all of packages/domain and proved the point the hard way: receipt/build.ts alone contributed 288 mutants no test covers, because it is print layout, and escpos another 105. That is 25 minutes to produce a report whose top of the list is not about money. Narrow scope is what makes the survivor list readable, and a readable list is the only kind anyone acts on.
_thresholdsComment: Measured, not guessed: the scoped run scores 78.99 total / 86.13 covered (657 killed, 106 survived, 69 uncovered, 7 minutes). `break` sits a few points under that — close enough that a real regression trips it, far enough that an ordinary refactor does not. It is a ratchet: raise it when the score clears it comfortably, and never lower it to make a build pass.
